messages:
hannah_cs: heads up — ACME (TICKET-4321) just escalated a structured-output break after yesterday's blue/green. They say our JSON schema no longer matches: the response is wrapped in a top-level "envelope" and the expected order.items array is now inside envelope.payload.order, plus order.id is coming back as a zero-padded string. they hit a 200 but their parser errors out. sample below.

jordan_se: can you paste the curl they used and the exact response blob? which deployment/model were they hitting? region?

hannah_cs: pasted from the customer (redacted):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{"model":"rw-infer","structured_output":true,"prompt":"format order as JSON"}'
```

response (200):
```json
{
  "envelope": {
    "meta": {
      "model": "rw-infer-v2-quant",
      "deploy": "bg-2026-03-15-14",
      "timestamp": "2026-03-15T14:22:10Z"
    },
    "payload": {
      "order": {
        "id": "000123",
        "items": "[{'sku':'X1','qty':2},{'sku':'X2','qty':1}]",
        "total": 54.99
      }
    }
  }
}
```

hannah_cs: note: items is a STRING (should be an array). Customer says this broke multiple parsers and caused downstream billing mismatches.

ev an_oncall: I pulled logs for trace id in the ticket: trace-0x7af3c. They hit prod-west and routed to deployment bg-2026-03-15-14. No 500s, only successful responses. I can see the model variant bumped to rw-infer-v2-quant during the blue/green.

olga_prod: deploy-bot event: bg-2026-03-15-14 promoted rw-infer-v2-quant -> prod at 2026-03-15T14:20Z.

deploy-bot: deployment bg-2026-03-15-14 completed (id:bg-2026-03-15-14, variant: rw-infer-v2-quant, rollout: blue-green).

jordan_se: hypothesis: the new variant emits an "envelope" wrapper and serializes nested lists as strings when structured_output=true (maybe a templating/serializer change). Could be a prompt-template tweak or a model behavior change after quantization.

ev an_oncall: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback bg to previous variant rw-infer-v1 for affected routes; 2) add a temporary response-mapping at the customer integration (map envelope.payload -> root) and coerce items string -> JSON array; 3) force structured_output:false for the customer until we confirm.

hannah_cs: ACME is high-volume and wants rollback. They can tolerate a brief outage but need schema stability. Their contract mentions schema SLAs.

jordan_se: I'll open a deploy rollback PR and run a quick canary for 30m. Also adding a unit regression test using ACME's schema + sample prompts so this doesn't slip by again.

olga_prod: root cause candidates: template change in the serving config that wraps outputs for telemetry; or model checkpoint emits a different serialization for nested lists after the quant pass. I've flagged eng-ml to run a diff on the prompt->output mapping between v1 and v2.

ev an_oncall: created an incident note and set severity P2 for customer-impacting schema regression. Trace: trace-0x7af3c attached to TICKET-4321.

jordan_se: immediate plan: rollback bg-2026-03-15-14 -> rw-infer-v1 for prod-west + notify ACME. I'll coordinate with olga for deployment window. If rollback is blocked, we'll push response-mapping and a small client-side hotfix.

hannah_cs: please ping me when rollback PR is merged. I'll update the customer and ask for their sample payloads from last successful run to add to our evals. :pray:

olga_prod: noted. tagging eng-ml and infra to prioritize. Also adding a postmortem item: add schema-eval gating to blue/green pipelines for structured_output routes.

jordan_se: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/pr/8729 (rollback bg-2026-03-15-14 -> rw-infer-v1). scheduling canary for 14:55Z.

ev an_oncall: will watch traces and metric alerts. will update thread with any parsing errors that persist after rollback.

hannah_cs: thanks. ACME asked for ETA ~30-45m. keeping them posted.
